package.name: cyton_ndi_capture
package.description: Standalone NDI Polaris measurement tool (ndi_measure) for checking MoveIt-commanded poses against independent NDI ground truth: position the arm via MoveIt/RViz, press Enter here to record a measurement, and it logs the live /joint_states alongside the NDI-measured moving-tool pose to CSV. This is the NDI *measurement* half only (the NdiTracker class and its dependencies, extracted from tests/ test_five_pose_ndi_capture.cpp and adapted: the Windows-only <conio.h> interactive pause/skip controls are stripped, and it reads the robot's current joint state from live ROS /joint_states instead of driving the arm itself via DynamixelMotor -- MoveIt does the moving now. See CLAUDE.md's kinematic-calibration section for the original methodology this reuses.
